entries.title: The Most Expensive GTM Mistake Is Repeating What Isn't Working
entries.audience: GTM leader, VP of Sales, CMO, RevOps leader
entries.summary: Teams repeat broken GTM motions because past success makes a strategy feel safer than it is. The diagnosis is separating execution problems from positioning problems — the same objections recurring despite strong execution signals a strategy issue, not an effort issue. Optimization theater (tweaking subject lines, CTAs, targeting) can't fix a motion that no longer fits the market. The right question isn't 'how do we improve this?' but 'is this still the right thing to improve?'

entries.title: AI-Led GTM Reinvention: The OAR Matrix and the Four Buying Lanes
entries.audience: GTM leader, RevOps leader, VP of Sales, CMO
entries.summary: The standard SaaS GTM playbook was built for 2018 and is structurally broken for 2026. The OAR Matrix (Optimize, Amplify, Reinvent) helps GTM leaders place AI correctly, and 75% of deal friction is internal — not from buyers. Within 18 months, every company will land in one of four buying lanes ranging from human-only to AI-to-AI.

entries.title: How to Rank #1 in ChatGPT: Your Guide to AEO
entries.audience: GTM leader, CMO, Marketing Ops, Demand Gen
entries.summary: Only 14% of marketers feel confident in their AEO strategy despite AI assistants becoming the primary B2B discovery layer. The six pillars of AI search visibility: topic depth, publishing velocity, content structure, crawl efficiency, content monitoring, and brand perception. AI-referred traffic converts better — making AEO a pipeline quality issue, not just a marketing one.

entries.title: More Data Isn't Creating More Clarity
entries.audience: GTM leader, RevOps leader, VP of Sales, CRO
entries.summary: GTM teams aren't struggling from lack of data — they're struggling because signal interpretation is fragmenting faster than orgs can coordinate. AI-referred buyers arrive pre-educated before entering any observable funnel. Efficient growth comes from system alignment, not activity volume.

entries.title: The GTM Repository for Claude Code
entries.audience: GTM leader, RevOps leader, Marketing Ops, Sales Ops
entries.summary: A GTM repository is a set of markdown files in a git repo that captures institutional GTM knowledge in structured, queryable form. Five-layer architecture: CLAUDE.md (persistent brain), context/ (ICP, signal library with decay + combinations, positioning, competitor radar, personas), skills/ (account research, signal-to-sequence, ICP scoring), workflows/ (enrichment, routing, campaign build), outputs/ (archive). Signal decay and signal combinations are critical: two signals together score higher than their sum.

entries.title: Content Engineering: How to Build a Content System in Claude Code
entries.audience: GTM leader, CMO, Marketing Ops, RevOps leader, Content Strategist
entries.summary: 90% of AI content quality comes from what you feed the system, not pipeline complexity. The fix is a five-file knowledge foundation (icp.md, personas.md, positioning.md, voice-guide.md, competitive-landscape.md) fed by sales call intelligence. One transcript generates SEO articles, LinkedIn posts, ABM personalization, and product insights through a six-stage pipeline with a human review gate.
